title: FOIA cover sheet
summary: Federal Bureau of Investigation, Freedom of Information/Privacy Acts Section cover sheet for the subject Guy Hottel, dated 3-22-1950.

title: Flying saucers, information concerning
summary: Office memorandum of March 22, 1950 from Guy Hottel, SAC Washington, to the FBI Director. A redacted source told an agent that an Air Force investigator said three flying saucers about 50 feet across were recovered in New Mexico, each holding three 3-foot bodies in fine metallic cloth. Government radar reportedly disrupted their controls. No further evaluation followed.
